subject: Private VPC pricing - follow-up & licensing questions
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@payments.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC pricing - follow-up & licensing questions

Alex — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery: you’re evaluating a Private/VPC deployment to host Payments.ai inference for transaction enrichment and risk scoring. Key items we captured: 

- Expected steady-state inference: ~15M tokens/day (chat & prompt mix).
- Peak batch windows up to ~40M tokens/day during batch scoring jobs.
- Need across three environments (dev, staging, prod), with prod isolated in your VPC and staging/dev in a shared sandbox.
- Data residency: US-only.
- SLA expectations: 99.9% availability for prod; 100ms p50 inference target for the main scoring route.

Next steps / asks from your side (so we can price accurately):
1) Ballpark budget range you’re targeting for the platform (monthly committed cost). If you can provide target $/1M tokens that helps our unit-economics modeling.
2) Confirm expected monthly token volume range (low / mid / high) — we can model licensing + token-unit costs across ranges.
3) Preferred support tier (Standard vs Business Critical / 24x7).
4) Any constraints on environment count or must all 3 be fully isolated in your VPC?

I attached a short pricing note (Redwood_Private_VPC_pricing_v1.pdf) that outlines our typical licensing + token unit structure for Private deployments. Primary licensing levers are: fixed annual platform license, per-environment runtime seats (prod vs non-prod), and per-token runtime unit economics (we offer volume tiers). We’ll map to your volumes once you confirm the ranges.

Would you prefer a quick 30-min call later this week to go through the pricing scenarios? I’m available Wed/Thu afternoons PT.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alex Nguyen <alex@payments.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@payments.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing - follow-up & licensing questions

Ben — thanks for the clear notes and the doc. A few quick answers below; happy to chat after.

1) Budget: we’re targeting $25k–$75k / month initially for infra + platform (trial to pilot). Our CFO is evaluating the steady-state spend and wants a unit target; ideally we see something in the range of $2,000–$5,000 per 1M tokens for pilot volumes, but we can get more precise once you break out license vs runtime.

2) Token volumes (monthly): low 200M, mid 450M, high 1.2B (this includes both online inference and scheduled batch scoring).

3) Support tier: leaning toward Business Critical for prod (24x7 on-call) given payment-risk sensitivity; standard for non-prod.

4) Environments: we need 3 environments as noted. Prod must be fully isolated in our VPC. Staging can be in a shared (but private) subnet; dev can be a shared sandbox.

A couple of follow-ups:
- Can you outline licensing model examples? We’d like to understand annual platform license vs per-environment seat vs per-token cost for the ranges above.
- Are there additional fees for KMS/HSM integrations or audit log retention beyond standard?

We’re free Thu 10–11am PT if you want to walk through the scenarios.

—Alex
Alex Nguyen
Head of ML Platforms
Payments.ai
alex@payments.ai | +1 (212) 555-0102
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@payments.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing - follow-up & licensing questions

Appreciate the detail, Alex — that helps a lot. Two things below at a high level; I’ve also updated the attached pricing note with a preliminary model for your mid/high scenarios (see v1.1 in the doc we’ll send after this thread).

Licensing model (high-level):
- Platform license (annual, fixed): covers control plane, updates, and platform features. Typical for an engagement of your size: $150k–$350k/year depending on SLAs/retention.
- Runtime seats (per-environment): we price by environment class (prod = dedicated runtime pool; non-prod = shared runtime). For you: prod (1) dedicated, staging (1) shared but isolated pool, dev (1) shared sandbox. Runtime seat fees are billed monthly and scale with provisioned capacity.
- Token unit economics: per-1M token unit charge that declines by tier. For the volumes you gave, rough ballpark ranges: $4,500–$6,000 / 1M tokens at pilot (200–450M/mo) dropping to $1,200–$2,000 / 1M tokens at 1B+ volumes depending on batching and quantization profile. We’ll model 3 scenarios (pilot / scale / high) with licensing + per-token to hit your $/1M target.
- Add-ons: KMS/HSM integrations typically have a one-time setup fee and a small monthly ops charge (we list as a separate line); extended audit-log retention is an incremental monthly fee depending on retention window.

Support: Business Critical adds 24x7 on-call, faster P1 SLAs, and an assigned Technical Account Manager — expect an uplift of ~20–35% on the platform + runtime fees vs Standard.

Next steps:
- I’ll prepare three line-item scenarios (pilot / scale / high) and share a short spreadsheet + updated PDF by EOD Wed.
- If Thu 10am PT works, let’s jump on a 30-min call to walk through the numbers and procurement steps. We’ll include our commercial ops lead if procurement needs to be looped.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
